summary: Retest of iter-46 fixes. ALL GREEN. (1) /auth/disable-2fa now returns 403 for non-admins (fix verified via new pytest test_all_2fa_endpoints_reject_non_admin and via frontend E2E non_admin_endpoints_403). (2) /auth/login now returns 401 (not 500) when the user row lacks password_hash — verified by a fresh seed-the-broken-row regression test. (3) /api/users now returns 200 (not 500) when a row lacks created_at — verified by a fresh seed-the-broken-row regression test. Backend pytest: 6/6 on test_two_factor_self_service.py + 2/2 on new test_hardening_regression.py. Frontend E2E: 12/12 on test_2fa_frontend_e2e.py (previously 11/12).
critical_code_review_comments: The 3 role-gate boilerplate blocks in setup/enable/disable-2fa are now consistent but still duplicated — extracting a `require_admin(user)` FastAPI dependency would prevent this bug class from recurring. Not blocking.

Hardenings for missing password_hash and missing created_at are tactical — the schema-level fix (Pydantic User model with defaults + migration to backfill legacy rows) remains the correct long-term solution. Not blocking.

test_credentials.md still advertises customer@test.com as a valid credential; the row is now hardened at the code level, but the fixture itself continues to be re-created manually by test agents. Consider making the seed script idempotent for this account.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_hardening_regression.py (NEW — 2 regression tests pinning the login-no-pwhash and users-no-created_at fixes)
test_credentials: Super admin: admin@bashari.com / admin123 (used for admin table + /api/users test). Customer: customer@test.com / customer123 (works). Per-test seeded super_admin and customer rows with uuid suffix, cleaned up.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-46 issues are closed. Backend pytest regression at /app/backend/tests/test_two_factor_self_service.py (6 tests, incl. the new role-gate test for all 3 endpoints) and /app/backend/tests/test_hardening_regression.py (2 tests). Frontend E2E at /app/tests/test_2fa_frontend_e2e.py — run with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/pw-browsers python tests/test_2fa_frontend_e2e.py` from /app. All green.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a retest confirming iter-46 fixes landed correctly. The root causes were: (a) disable-2fa was missing the role gate because the gate was retrofitted onto setup/enable but not disable; (b) legacy user rows in Mongo lacked password_hash and/or created_at because the user model evolved after they were seeded. Fixes verified at the endpoint level via live HTTP tests against broken rows seeded fresh at test time.
